notablePrerequisites:
Squirrel Nest attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.
